character_design_spec:
A compact, chibi-proportioned vinyl-toy style cute robot engineered specifically for watertight manifold 3D reconstruction and support-free FDM 3D printing.
- Proportions & Silhouette: 1:1.2 head-to-body ratio with a rounded-cubic head, stout barrel-shaped torso, thick cylindrical arms held in a clean symmetric A-pose (angled 25 degrees away from the torso with thick, solid integrated ball-shoulder joints), and short, stocky pillar legs terminating in oversized, completely flat-soled blocky boots for maximum build-plate adhesion and self-supporting stability.
- Printability & Manifold Geometry: Zero floating geometry, zero paper-thin wires, and zero fragile spindly antennae. Instead of thin antennae, the top of the head features two thick, stubby, rounded-cone ear-nodes solidly fused to the cranial shell. All panel lines, seams, and vents are sculpted as bold, chamfered reliefs (minimum 2mm equivalent depth/width) rather than hairline scratches.
- Color & Material Palette: Matte pastel sky-blue primary chassis, warm cream-white faceplate and chest inset, charcoal-grey recessed joint rings and visor screen, and bright coral-orange ear-nodes and chest heart badge.
- Explicit Directional Landmarks:
  * FRONT View (0°): Features a large recessed rounded-rectangular charcoal visor displaying two glowing cyan oval digital eyes and a cheerful curved smile line; a recessed cream-white chest plate with an embossed coral-orange heart icon on the left pectoral and three chunky horizontal pill-shaped status buttons on the right.
  * BACK View (180°): Completely distinct from the front—features a chunky, rounded-trapezoid dorsal battery backpack solidly fused to the upper torso, detailed with a large circular central turbine cooling vent and two vertical chamfered exhaust louvers below it; the back of the head has a smooth convex cranial plate with a single vertical recessed data-port slot.
  * LEFT Profile View (90°, facing left): Shows the left shoulder's circular bolted cap embossed with a bold raised star emblem, the forward protrusion of the facial visor bezel, and the rearward protrusion of the dorsal battery backpack.
  * RIGHT Profile View (270°, facing right): Shows the right shoulder's circular bolted cap embossed with a bold raised lightning-bolt emblem, matching the exact height, depth, and silhouette geometry of the left profile in reverse orientation.

turnaround_image_prompt:
A single square 1:1 (1024x1024) 2x2 orthographic character turnaround reference sheet of a cute chibi vinyl-toy robot, designed for 3D reconstruction.

EXACT 2x2 QUADRANT LAYOUT:
- Top-Left Quadrant: Strict orthographic FRONT view (0 degrees, facing straight toward the camera), clearly showing the dark rounded-rectangular facial visor with two glowing cyan oval eyes and smile, and the cream-white chest panel with a raised coral-orange heart badge and three chunky horizontal pill buttons.
- Top-Right Quadrant: Strict orthographic LEFT profile view (90-degree side view, robot facing left), clearly showing the flat front visor profile, the protruding rear battery backpack, and a raised star emblem on the left shoulder cap.
- Bottom-Left Quadrant: Strict orthographic BACK view (180-degree rear view, facing away from the camera), clearly showing the smooth back of the head with a single vertical slot and the chunky dorsal battery backpack with a central circular turbine vent and two vertical exhaust louvers.
- Bottom-Right Quadrant: Strict orthographic RIGHT profile view (270-degree side view, robot facing right), clearly showing the protruding rear battery backpack on the left side of the silhouette, the front visor on the right side, and a raised lightning-bolt emblem on the right shoulder cap.

GEOMETRY & POSE CONSISTENCY:
Compact, sturdy, watertight toy proportions with a rounded-cubic head, two thick stubby coral-orange ear-nodes fused to the top of the head, stout pastel sky-blue torso, thick articulated cylindrical arms in a symmetric standing A-pose, and short stocky legs with wide, completely flat-bottomed boots. No thin wires, no fragile antennae, no floating parts. Identical character geometry, exact same vertical height, horizontal alignment, and scale across all 4 quadrants. Each of the 4 views is well-centered inside its quadrant with at least 15% empty white margin around the entire silhouette so no part touches the image edges or quadrant boundaries.

LIGHTING & BACKGROUND:
Pure solid flat white (#FFFFFF) background across the entire canvas. Soft, even, shadowless studio global illumination with matte clay/vinyl-toy shading. Zero cast floor shadows, zero ground plane, zero pedestal, zero dividing grid lines, zero borders, and zero text or labels anywhere in the image.
